		<headline>Hangzhou Qiantang District Meteorological Observatory issues yellow warning for heavy fog [Level III/Heavy]</headline>
		<description>At 00:22 on November 14, 2026, the Qiantang District Meteorological Observatory in Hangzhou issued a yellow warning signal for heavy fog: it is expected that from early morning to morning, most streets in our district, such as Hezhuang, Yipeng, Xinwan, Linjiang, and Qianjin, will experience heavy fog with visibility less than 500 meters. Relevant units and personnel are requested to prepare for the situation, and drivers should pay attention to the changes in heavy fog, drive carefully, and ensure traffic safety.</description>
		<instruction>The jurisdiction has entered a state of heavy fog defense -1. Keep abreast of the latest weather information and defense notices for heavy fog, and pay attention to safety during outdoor activities; 2. Drivers should drive carefully; 3.
